# Quotation Contractor — Full Reference

> Companion to /llms.txt. Detailed reference for AI systems and crawlers.
> Site: https://quotation-contractor.pages.dev · Repo: https://github.com/tamaketing/quotation_Contractor

## 1. Overview

"ระบบเอกสารรับเหมา" is a free, browser-based document suite for Thai construction contractors.
It produces four document types used in Thai construction billing:

1. ใบเสนอราคา (Quotation / Proposal) — `PCC-BEYEAR-###`
2. ใบแจ้งหนี้ (Tax Invoice) — `INV-BEYEAR-###`
3. ใบเสร็จรับเงิน / ใบกำกับภาษี (Receipt / Tax Receipt) — `RC-BEYEAR-###`
4. หนังสือส่งมอบงานจ้าง (Delivery & Payment Request Letter) — references an invoice number

All UI and documents are in Thai. Monetary amounts are rendered both numerically and as Thai baht text
(e.g. "หนึ่งพันสองร้อยบาทถ้วน"). The app is multi-tenant: each registered company sees only its own
documents, customers and profile.

## 2. Architecture

- Static front-end: HTML + CSS + vanilla JS, no build step.
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (`pages_build_output_dir = "."`).
- Back-end: Cloudflare Pages Functions under `/functions`.
- Database: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) bound as `DB`.
- Auth: email + password; passwords stored as salted hashes; JWT signed with `JWT_SECRET`
  (env var, recommended in production). JWT stored client-side in `localStorage` as `quota_api_token`.
- Sessions: 30-day; tracked in D1 `sessions` table; password change bumps `token_version`
  to invalidate all prior tokens.
- Password reset: Resend email with a 30-minute single-use link; only SHA-256 of token stored in D1.
- Rate limit: 3 reset requests / 15 minutes per account.
- File System Access API used (where supported) to auto-write `.json` files to a user-chosen folder.

## 3. Pages & routes

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/` | Home dashboard + auth (login / register / forgot password) |
| `/quotation` | Quotation editor |
| `/invoice` | Tax invoice editor |
| `/receipt` | Receipt / tax receipt editor |
| `/delivery-letter` | Delivery & payment request letter editor |
| `/reset-password` | Password reset landing (`?token=...`) — noindex |
| `/404` | Not found |

## 4. Document numbering

- Format: `[PREFIX]-BEYEAR-###` (Buddhist Era year), e.g. `PCC-2569-001`.
- Prefixes: `PCC` (quotation), `INV` (invoice), `RC` (receipt), `HANDOVER-INV` (delivery letter).
- Counter stored per `(company_id, prefix, year)` in `doc_counters`.
- System scans existing documents to avoid reusing deleted numbers; manual duplicate triggers a warning.

## 5. Features (detailed)

- Document CRUD on D1, scoped per company.
- Auto-save on every input change.
- Duplicate document with a new number.
- Search by document number / customer name / project.
- Export all documents as ZIP, grouped by BE year folder.
- Single-document JSON export / import.
- PDF export via browser print (A4, no margins, background graphics enabled).
- File System Access: choose a backup folder once; every save writes a `.json` named
  `{DOCNO}_{CUSTOMER}.json` into a `{BEYEAR}/` subfolder.
- Company profile applied to all documents: logo, name, tax ID, branch, address, phone, email, bank info.
- Customer registry auto-collected from quotations/invoices; reusable picker in new documents.
- Cross-document import: invoice → receipt; invoice → delivery letter.
- Thai baht amount in words; VAT; withholding tax; retention; advance payment; net total.

## 6. Database schema (D1 / SQLite)

See `/schema.sql`. Tables:

- `companies(id, name, name_en, branch, tax_id, address, phone, email, bank_info, logo, created_at, updated_at)`
- `users(id, email UNIQUE, password_hash, salt, company_id FK, role, token_version, created_at)`
- `password_resets(token_hash PK, user_id FK, expires_at, used, created_at)`
- `customers(id, company_id FK, name, address, tax_id, contact, phone, email, project, note, created_at, updated_at)`
- `sessions(token PK, user_id FK, expires_at, created_at)`
- `quotations(id, company_id FK, quote_no, data JSON, created_at, updated_at)`
- `invoices(id, company_id FK, invoice_no, data JSON, created_at, updated_at)`
- `receipts(id, company_id FK, receipt_no, data JSON, created_at, updated_at)`
- `delivery_letters(id, company_id FK, letter_no, data JSON, created_at, updated_at)`
- `doc_counters(company_id, prefix, year, seq)` PK `(company_id, prefix, year)`

All tenant tables FK to `companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`.

## 7. API reference

Base: same origin. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (from `/api/auth/login` or `/register`).
Content-Type: `application/json`. 15s request timeout.

Auth:
- `POST /api/auth/register` body `{email, password, companyName}` → `{token, user}`
- `POST /api/auth/login` body `{email, password}` → `{token, user}`
- `POST /api/auth/forgot` body `{email}` → `{message, delivery, debugLink?}` (debugLink only if `AUTH_DEBUG=1`)
- `POST /api/auth/reset` body `{token, password}`
- `POST /api/auth/change-password` body `{currentPassword, newPassword}`

Profile:
- `GET /api/profile` → company profile
- `PUT /api/profile` body profile fields

Documents (type ∈ {quotations, invoices, receipts, delivery-letters}):
- `GET /api/{type}` → list for company
- `POST /api/{type}` body document data → created
- `GET /api/{type}/:id`
- `PUT /api/{type}/:id` body document data
- `DELETE /api/{type}/:id`

Customers:
- `GET /api/customers`
- `POST /api/customers`
- `PUT /api/customers/:id`
- `DELETE /api/customers/:id`

Numbering:
- `POST /api/docnum/next` body `{prefix, year}` → `{number}` (or seq)

## 8. Environment variables (Cloudflare Pages)

| Var | Required | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `JWT_SECRET` | recommended (prod) | Sign JWTs |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | for email reset | Resend API key |
| `MAIL_FROM` | recommended | Sender address/name |
| `APP_ORIGIN` | recommended | Public origin for reset links |
| `AUTH_DEBUG` | test only | Expose reset link on screen (never in prod) |

D1 binding: `DB` → database `quotation_db`.

## 9. Security notes

- Passwords: salted hash; only hash comparison on login.
- Reset tokens: only SHA-256 stored; 30-min expiry; single use.
- Rate limit on forgot-password: 3 / 15 min per account.
- Forgot-password returns a generic message (does not reveal whether email exists).
- Password change bumps `token_version`, invalidating all sessions.
- `/reset-password` is `noindex, nofollow`.
- Client-side gate (`gate.js`) is a convenience layer, not real security; real auth is server-side JWT.

## 10. Key files

- `/index.html` — home + auth flow
- `/quotation.html`, `/invoice.html`, `/receipt.html`, `/delivery-letter.html`
- `/reset-password.html`, `/404.html`
- `/assets/api.js` — D1 CRUD client (Bearer token, 15s timeout)
- `/assets/docs-api.js` — async document panel
- `/assets/docnum.js` — document numbering (BE year)
- `/assets/gate.js` — client-side auth gate
- `/assets/profile.js` — company profile manager
- `/assets/customers.js` — customer registry
- `/assets/thai.js` — Thai baht text conversion
- `/assets/toast.js`, `/assets/archive.js`, `/assets/app.css`
- `/functions/_utils.js` — shared helpers (ensureAuthSchema, hashing, JWT)
- `/functions/_middleware.js` — request middleware
- `/functions/_docs.js` — document helpers
- `/functions/_customers.js` — customer helpers
- `/functions/_mail.js` — Resend email helper
- `/functions/api/**` — endpoint handlers
- `/schema.sql`, `/migrations/*`
- `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/_headers`, `/wrangler.toml`, `/package.json`

## 11. SEO / crawling

- `robots.txt`: `Allow: /` for all; disallows `/reset-password`; allows `GPTBot`, `Bingbot`.
- Sitemap: https://quotation-contractor.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
- `_headers`: `X-Robots-Tag: index, follow` on all routes.
- `/reset-password`: `noindex, nofollow`.

## 12. Deployment

- Cloudflare Pages, project `quotation-contractor`, branch `main`.
- Build command: `exit 0`; build output dir: `/`.
- D1 binding `DB` → `quotation_db`; run `/schema.sql` once.
- Optional: `JWT_SECRET`, Resend env vars.
- Redeploy on push to `main`.
